졸림: 카페인 30μl + 설탕 150μl. 메스꺼움: 단백질 150μl + 미네랄 60μl.

20ml에서는 한 조합에 설탕 300μl + 단백질 300μl가 필요합니다. 세 조합이면 각각 900μl가 필요합니다. 이미 들어 있는 재료를 계산하고 차이만큼만 추가하세요.

각 재료 단위는 한 번만 배정되지만, 여러 조합을 위해 더 넣을 수 있습니다. 피로 조합 3개와 불면 조합 3개에는 단백질 3회분이 아니라 6회분이 필요합니다.

Additives involve tradeoffs: dream cap extract improves analgesia but causes drowsiness, protein supports repair, minerals support protection, stabilizer improves stability, caffeine supports strength and reduces drowsiness, but impairs concealment. Excess additives can cause discomfort.
Blossom: primarily repair, secondarily protection. Useful for care or as an alternative source of protection. Tide helps its repair effect.
Ember: primarily protection, secondarily strength. Higher concentrations cause heat. Mixing it with Spectral can compromise stability and concealment.

Effects have grades I, II and III. Effects below grade I are not listed on the product. Water lowers concentration, equal division changes volume without changing grades. Gentle orders may reject overly strong effects.
Each powder has a primary and a weaker secondary effect. Extraction consumes 3g of raw powder per 1ml equivalent of active ingredient. Water dilutes effects; no fixed water proportion is required.
Nightmare: primarily analgesia, secondarily concealment. Higher concentrations cause more drowsiness; mixtures with exertion ingredients can cause fatigue.
Spectral: primarily concealment, secondarily analgesia. Useful for discretion or pain relief; higher concentrations cause fatigue.
Tide: primarily strength, secondarily repair. Useful for exertion and care; higher concentrations cause thirst.
The current mixture or solvent exceeds the recipe in an active component. Replace the solvent or cancel the target.

Each reaction supports up to three pairs, reducing the treatable portion by 50%, 80% and 90%. Each unit is counted once, but extra supply can serve multiple pairs. Allocation proceeds in rounds, prioritizing severe or selected reactions.

A single effect has intrinsic adverse effects that increase with strength. Multiple effects add nausea. Excitement and Calm create a strong conflict without cancelling positive effects. Stabilizer only reduces mixture and conflict strain, not contamination.

Scrap powders contribute independently and positive effects plateau. Concentrated powders add intrinsic strain, multiple effects add a separate mixture burden. Auxiliaries reach full relief at their preferred dose, more adds no relief and amounts above twice that dose add adverse properties. Harmonization removes most strain but cannot clean pollution.
Mushes, contraceptives and livestock serums are not harmonizing auxiliaries. Other native processing chemicals retain their original reactions and do not automatically improve finished potions.

Auxiliaries primarily reduce adverse properties: protein and sugar ease fatigue, minerals relieve thirst and heaviness, caffeine relieves sedation, and dream-cap extract eases agitation and insomnia. Stabilizer reduces base mixture and strong-conflict burdens, not pollution or individual powder overload. Fanta retains pain relief, with penalties for excess.

Fish powder determines effects, auxiliaries reduce specific adverse properties, and water adjusts concentration. The Fish Scrap Grinder selects powder by source species and yields 25% of ordinary scrap weight or 1% for Great White Shark scrap the next day. Dilution does not remove impurities.
